marta: Quick follow-up on the fidelity-hint propagation RFC. I sketched a minimal contract that travels with a request through tokenizer->prefill->generation->cache and back. LMK if this shape is ok before I open a PR.

raj: Can you paste the example?

marta: Sure — idea is a tiny header + a compact fingerprint.

```
X-Redwood-Fidelity: mode=prefer-fp8;min_mode=int8;score=0.88
X-Redwood-Fid-Fingerprint: v1:8b:3f7a
# Or compact bitmask in binary for runtime
fid=0b01101
```

sam: Nice. Main ops concern: header + fingerprint should be <= 64 bytes to avoid perf hit on LB. Also we can't change the public API without migration plan.

jin: Telemetry: we need 3 telemetry keys emitted per-request: fidelity.requested, fidelity.actual, fidelity.fallback_reason. Add SLI to track quality regressions.

marta: Agreed. Rollout plan I'm proposing:
- SDK adds header (opt-in flag default=false) for canary customers
- Runtime honors hint if compatible, otherwise runs fallback policy: 1) try compatible quant-profile, 2) if fails, fall back to safe FP16 model
- Emit telemetry and tag traces with fid fingerprint
- Canary 10% of traffic for 48h, auto-rollback on quality-signal spike

raj: How do we compute 'compatibility'? At runtime we compare fingerprint against model profile whitelist, right?

marta: Yes — runtime will have a fingerprint -> profile map. If mismatch treat as incompatible. We should version fingerprints (v1) to enable future fields.

sam: Ops: add lint to reject headers > 80 bytes and a gateway filter to strip unknown fid versions. Also, add metric for "header-dropped-by-gateway".

ops-bot: deploy/prod:canary started for fidelity-header-gateway v1 — 2026-03-23T15:42Z :rocket:

jin: Also add unit tests for cache keys — we need to ensure fid is part of KV cache key when mode affects kv semantics.

marta: Good catch. I'll add test matrix and a small perf microbenchmark. Planning PR today. @raj @sam can you review the runtime fingerprint map format? If ok I'll open RFC->PR.

raj: I'll take runtime spec. sam: I'll do gateway lint + rollout checklist.

marta: Thanks folks. If nobody objects I'll open PR around EOD. :thumbsup:
